method: Read primary GitHub source/documents through the GitHub connector. Remote main/master files are current source inspections, not released-package guarantees. Local experimental sources are pinned separately in experiments/native-runtime/snapshot.json.

sources.supports: Template preparation/instance updates; property, attribute and event binding distinction; event handler replacement.
_commitTemplateResult reuses matching instances; PropertyPart and EventPart implement distinct DOM operations.
Explicit key change disposes prior DOM even when the template is the same.
Documented reactive-object destructuring, replacement and primitive-argument limitations.
Proposal combines standard JavaScript, updatable templates, explicit DOM binding surfaces and fine-grained observable updates. It is not shipped platform support.
